events.evidence: Russian forces launch overnight strikes in Kyiv, Ukraine, hitting among other targets, a residential building in eastern Darnytskyi district, killing 16 people
Honda suspends plans to build an electric vehicle (EV) plant in Ontario, Canada, citing weaker demand for EVs and the impact of United States tariffs
Cuba announces it has completely run out of diesel fuel due to a U.S. blockade of the island

label.note: Kyiv mass-casualty strike, Cuba fuel blockade and tariff-hit Honda plant lean risk-off.
